entry.title: Ooze Level June 2026: 26/100 (Sticky)
entry.summary: The June 2026 Ooze Level sealed at 27 out of 100 — Sticky territory, down 3 from May 2026. Calmer than 6 of every 10 months since 2003. The heaviest line was housing at 6 ounces. The relief came from the two lines everyone feels first: gas prices (down 11 points) and inflation (down 9 points). Every figure is computed from cited public data and passed the facility's integrity gate before publication.
